source: ChatGPT/Codex-authored NFL probabilities using Data Dawgs public nfelo, 538 Classic and canonical schedule snapshots; no private user forecasts
tier_meaning: Pup — live and useful, not yet validated. It may compute real answers and still have open questions about calibration, assumptions, data quality or edge. Everything starts here.

data.author: ChatGPT / Codex
data.method: Data-only probabilistic judgment anchored to current published nfelo and Classic Elo, with attributable republished market context where available. Inputs are correlated: this is NOT an independent model or a validated edge. Directional disagreements lead to moderate forecasts, generally leaning toward current nfelo. For an upcoming game without a published nfelo probability, use the public nfelo-season-v1 inputs to calculate an explicitly labelled fixed-strength season projection, not a market price or official nfelo game forecast. No independent injury, lineup or news adjustment is claimed. Preserve receipts where inputs and judgment are not materially changed. The on-page chat assistant is a separate service.

inputs.hash_method: Exact packet input_snapshot_id: Worker SHA-256 of JSON.stringify({schedule: schedule.integrity, nfelo: nfelo.data.meta, classic: classic.integrity, models: modelRows}); not a concatenated-file hash.
inputs.note: This metadata describes the latest authored rows. Retained rows retain their own original timestamps and input_snapshot_id.
